column1: # ComputerBase — Sieben CPUs von AMD und Intel unter 200 Euro im Test.
# Gaming-Benchmarks, 720p, GeForce RTX 5090 FE. 720p is deliberate: it
# removes the graphics card as a limit so the processors separate.
# THIS FILE IS ONE BENCH: DDR5-5200CL26 (AM5 Zen 4).
# The review is cross-platform, so its rows are split into one file per
# memory configuration. AM4 physically cannot take DDR5 — a chip's own
# platform memory is its stock configuration, not a deviation from a
# standard, so it is a separate bench rather than a refused row.
# REFUSED, with the reason rather than a silent gap:
#   · CP2077 Phantom Liberty — run with "RT Niedrig" and no raster preset named — the cell key has no ray-tracing slot
#   · Cyberpunk 2077 — run with "RT Niedrig" and no raster preset named — the cell key has no ray-tracing slot
#   · Homeworld 3 — "Grafik-Preset Hoch, DLSS" states no DLSS quality; the corpus refuses an upscaler whose render fraction nobody wrote down
#   · Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 — ComputerBase itself excludes it from every rating — "extrem inkonsistente Werte", unstable on smaller CPUs
#   · every (sim.) row — a SIMULATED "9600X3D", a part nobody can buy
#   · every (cTDP), (Turbo GM) and (CU) row — the same chip run non-stock,
#     charted alongside its own stock twin and colliding with it on entry id
#   · every CPU Package Power chart — a wattage, not a frame rate
#   · Ryzen 5 7600X3D, Ryzen 9 9900X3D, i5-12600KF, Core Ultra 5 225F and
#     235 — charted, but no catalogue part matches
# ⚠️ ComputerBase states these results are NOT comparable with their own
# earlier parcours (new GPU, patches, drivers, Windows updates). They share
# cells with the 9800X3D review, whose rows ran an RTX 4090 — the fit is
# relative so this is meta-analysis rather than an error, but cv on the
# shared cells is the number to watch.
# Settings read per game off "Die Einstellungen der 19 Spiele im Detail
# (stets 720p-Auflösung)" on the article's own benchmark page.
title:     DDR5-5200CL26 — Sieben CPUs von AMD und Intel unter 200 Euro im Test
